name: @hype-comms/desktop
description: Secure Electron desktop client for Hype Comms

scripts.package: npm run build && node ../../scripts/build-macos-notification-authorization.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node ../../scripts/build-macos-notification-authorization.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:win:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis:arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux AppImage:arm64 deb:arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:appimage: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux AppImage --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:appimage:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux AppImage:arm64 --publish never
